description: Machine-readable registry for Agent-driven OpenClip Analysis planning.

conventions.agent_instruction: Read AGENT_TOOL_GUIDE.md first, then use this registry to recommend a plan and wait for user confirmation before high-cost VLM tools.

tools.name: VideoMetadataExtractor
run_when: any video workflow starts
video duration/fps/audio presence are unknown
skip_when: trusted video_metadata.json already exists and user does not need refresh
tools.agent_notes: Use duration, fps, frame count, and audio presence to estimate downstream runtime.

tools.name: AudioASRPipeline
run_when: video may contain speech
semantic segmentation needs transcript
subtitle output is needed
skip_when: video has no audio and user accepts visual-only workflow
tools.agent_notes: Inspect ASR coverage, silence ranges, and quality to decide whether 07 is needed.

tools.name: SourceSeparation
run_when: background music is strong
ASR hallucination or timestamp drift is suspected
VAD/ASR should operate on vocals instead of mixed audio
skip_when: demucs is unavailable and user accepts mixed-audio ASR
tools.agent_notes: Run before 02 when music-heavy videos make ASR unreliable. Use vocals.wav as the future VAD/ASR source.

tools.name: SemanticLLMStructureBuilder
run_when: semantic-first timeline is required
13/14/15/16 downstream outputs are expected
skip_when: user only needs raw ASR or raw visual analysis

estimated_runtime.basis: one or few LLM calls over transcript/final prompt

tools.agent_notes: Core dependency for 08-16. After running, inspect segment durations to decide 11/12.

tools.name: PySceneDetectRunner
run_when: visual cuts/keyframes may help segmentation
05/06/08/09 may be used
tools.agent_notes: Use cut_count and confidence to decide whether 06 or 09 may be useful.

tools.name: VisualEvidenceExtractor
run_when: keyframe evidence is needed
14 VLM retake descriptions may be needed
visual boundary decisions may be needed

estimated_runtime.basis: video duration, source mode, number of frames extracted

tools.agent_notes: Use visual boundary counts and keyframe availability to decide 09 and 14.

tools.name: VisualOCRTimelineBuilder
run_when: on-screen text may carry semantic meaning
slides, title cards, data charts, screenshots, or document pages are present
03 should combine ASR with visual text evidence
skip_when: no OCR engine is available and user accepts ASR-only segmentation

estimated_runtime.basis: number of keyframes and OCR engine

tools.agent_notes: Independent OCR pass over 05 keyframes. It classifies subtitle candidates separately from product/visual text and records Scene-OCR alignment.

tools.name: SubtitleBidirectionalCalibrator
run_when: visual OCR subtitle candidates should be reconciled with ASR
ASR and OCR need bidirectional SRT calibration
03 should consume calibrated subtitle evidence
skip_when: no OCR subtitle candidates exist and ASR quality is sufficient

estimated_runtime.basis: ASR and OCR timeline item count

tools.agent_notes: Uses high-quality ASR to correct OCR subtitle text/time and uses stable OCR subtitles to fill ASR gaps or correct drift. 03 should prefer its outputs when present.

tools.name: SceneTransitionLLMJudge
run_when: physical shooting-location transition accuracy is important
video has multiple locations
pyscenedetect cut count is high
final timeline needs reliable location transition evidence
skip_when: video appears to have one stable location
user does not need strict location boundaries
cut count is low and visual variation is weak
tools.agent_notes: Ask user before running unless already approved. Use --resume for reruns.

tools.name: SilentVisualSegmentDetector
run_when: ASR has long silent intervals
silent visual actions or B-roll may matter

estimated_runtime.basis: ASR intervals and visual evidence counts

tools.agent_notes: Do not run automatically for complete spoken videos unless silence analysis suggests it.

tools.name: BoundaryAligner
run_when: semantic boundaries should be aligned to visual evidence
13 detail timeline should use better boundary timing
skip_when: only rough semantic boundaries are needed
visual evidence is unavailable and timing need not be adjusted
tools.agent_notes: Generally useful and low-cost after 03/04/05.

tools.name: VisualBoundaryPromoter
run_when: 05 finds strong visual boundary candidates
detail segmentation should be more visual-aware
semantic boundaries alone miss visible transitions
tools.agent_notes: It does not modify timeline directly; 13 consumes its outputs.

tools.name: EvidenceCollector
run_when: audit trail or explainability is needed
later QA should reference unused/supporting evidence
skip_when: minimal fast run and audit is not needed
tools.agent_notes: Useful for debugging; missing optional inputs are reported instead of failing.

tools.name: OverCoarseSegmentRefiner
run_when: 03 produces long semantic segments
segments contain dense ASR or many internal cuts
balanced timeline needs safer splits
skip_when: semantic segments are already practical length
tools.agent_notes: Suggestions-only; 13 consumes safe split suggestions.

tools.name: OverFragmentedSegmentMerger
run_when: 03 produces too many short segments
adjacent segments share topic/formula slot
balanced timeline needs practical merged edits
tools.agent_notes: Suggestions-only; 13 consumes merge suggestions.

tools.name: SceneSRTCalibrator
run_when: detail timeline should use Scene-level SRT calibrated by ASR/OCR and SceneDetect
product-host videos need SRT-driven fine scene alignment
skip_when: only rough semantic timeline is needed

estimated_runtime.basis: scene count and subtitle alignment item count

tools.agent_notes: Uses PySceneDetect scenes by default. It consumes 05_2 calibrated subtitles and ASR to generate Scene-level SRT for detail timeline.

tools.name: FineTimelineBuilder
run_when: final detail timeline is needed
final detail/balanced/summary timelines are needed when explicitly requested
skip_when: user only needs upstream analysis and no timeline output
tools.agent_notes: Defaults to detail-only. When scene_srt_segments.json exists, detail dialogue uses 13_01 calibrated Scene SRT. Use --no-detail-only --schemes detail,balanced,summary for all schemes.

tools.name: SegmentDescriptorSubtitleBuilder
run_when: retake descriptions are required
final scheme packages need segment JSON
visual production guidance is needed
skip_when: only timeline or raw clips are needed
no retake description deliverables are required

estimated_runtime.basis: rule=low; vlm=one VLM call per detail segment

tools.agent_notes: Use --description-mode vlm for production. Ask user before running VLM mode unless already approved.

tools.name: SchemeExportValidator
run_when: deliverable scheme folders are needed
each segment needs mp4+srt+json
timeline coverage report should be exported
skip_when: user only needs analysis JSON and not exported clips

estimated_runtime.basis: number of exported clips and encode mode

tools.agent_notes: Default exports all three schemes: scheme_1=detail, scheme_2=balanced, scheme_3=summary. Use --schemes detail for a staged export that outputs only scheme_1 first; the result records selected_schemes, partial_export, and scheme_mapping for 16 QA.

tools.name: SemanticFirstQualityChecker
run_when: final quality gate is needed
deliverables were produced
user asks for validation
skip_when: exploratory upstream-only run and no final validation needed
tools.agent_notes: Run at the end of any delivery workflow. It reads 15 selected_schemes/scheme_mapping and validates only exported schemes for staged delivery, while preserving full three-scheme validation when 15 exports all schemes.

tools.name: DetailSchemeRecomposer
run_when: user is dissatisfied with balanced or summary grouping
detail scheme is acceptable but target scheme needs regrouping
no upstream video analysis should be rerun
skip_when: visual evidence or ASR must be regenerated

estimated_runtime.basis: one text LLM call plus local JSON/SRT regeneration and target-scheme clip export

main_outputs: schemes/scheme_2/ for balanced or schemes/scheme_3/ for summary
tools.agent_notes: Closed-loop recomposer for a single target scheme. Balanced exports only schemes/scheme_2; summary exports only schemes/scheme_3. It does not rerun 03/06/08/10/13/14 and does not export unrelated schemes.
